description: drive.files.update: PATCH files/{fileId}.  Updates a file's metadata, content, or both. When calling this method, only populate fields in the request that you want to modify. When updating fields, some fields might be changed automatically, such as `modifiedDate`. This method supports patch semantics. This method supports an */upload* URI and accepts uploaded media with the following characteristics: - *Maximum file size:* 5,120 GB - *Accepted Media MIME types:* `*/*` (Specify a valid MIME type, rather than the literal `*/*` value. The literal `*/*` is only used to indicate that any valid MIME type can be uploaded. For more information, see [Google Workspace and Google Drive supported MIME types](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/mime-types).) For more information on uploading files, see [Upload file data](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads). Runs as a background job; completion preserves vendor response fields and names the selected account. Pass pageToken for the next page. Parameters use exact vendor names. See workspace_api_coverage.md for body schemas, scopes and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Drive Files Update to  updates a file's metadata, content, or both. Acts on the selected connected Google account and returns Google's complete response, including pagination tokens when available. Supply vendor field names for filters, request bodies and updates.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion includes account, method and full vendor response or media blob.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show paging tokens so the caller can continue.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return one short message through the active IO plugin.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.invalid_params names invalid arguments; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied includes tier or vendor denial; gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Choose a connected account, correct vendor parameters, or reconnect with start_interface and connect_account to approve missing scopes. Retry rate limits later.
